items.title: Navigating messaging requirements in betting and gaming technology applications (Part 2: Executing the registration and maintaining compliance)
items.summary: Part 2 of the betting and gaming messaging series: how to write use-case descriptions and opt-in documentation that win carrier approval, how to keep MFA messaging compliant and deliverable after approval, and how to respond if your registration is denied.
items.creator: Meghana Dasigi

items.title: Navigating messaging requirements in betting and gaming technology applications (Part 1: Understanding the landscape and preparing your application)
items.summary: Betting and gaming operators are classified as high-risk by carriers, so registering numbers for SMS MFA and account-verification messages faces heightened scrutiny. Part 1 covers how registration works across AWS and the carriers, why the industry is treated differently, and how to prepare a strong application with AWS End User Messaging before you submit.
items.creator: Meghana Dasigi
